_comment: The Vivi Ornitier shape: a mana ability producing X mana freely split across two colours, where X reads the board. A choose_mode of two add_manas is the near miss and offers X of one colour or X of the other, never a genuine mix.

cards.name: Test Split Mage
cards.oracle_text: {0}: Add X mana in any combination of {U} and/or {R}, where X is Test Split Mage's power. Activate only during your turn and only once each turn.

abilities.text: {0}: Add X mana in any combination of {U} and/or {R}, where X is Test Split Mage's power. Activate only during your turn and only once each turn.
